title: Mechanical mole
prompt: A labelled scale teaching cutaway of the page 67 mechanical mole moves through a clear-sided soft-ground box. Bore rotates the cutter head while an external feed moves the model into the workface. Remove spoil turns the auger and conveyor to carry loosened material backward out of the tunnel. Line tunnel externally places a supporting lining ring behind the head as a teaching operation. Show only cutter head, spoil auger, conveyor, tunnel and lining. Do not invent thrust rams, a shield erection system or a powered ring installer.
blurb: A scale teaching cutaway shows a rotating cutter, horizontal screw spoil transport and tunnel lining, with external feed and ring placement.
adaptation: External model feed and external lining-ring placement are teaching operations; power transmission and installation machinery are not inferred.

editions.2016: saved page 67 text and supplied image inspected

truthNotes: Finite specimen permits three 18 mm advances and exactly 18 spoil pieces per advance.
Rotating cutter blades cut the workface; the auger conveys loosened spoil rearward onto the conveyor.
The conveyor empties outside the tunnel; removed ground and removed spoil persist.
Lining placement is external. No rams, powered installer, shield erection system or automatic lining mechanism.
Labels include anatomy and physical features of the tunnel and lining. Teaching fixtures and action overlays are excluded.
Horizontal screw conveyance differs from vertical batch lifting by a construction auger and from mincer cutting.
Scale model dimensions are illustrative. No literal drawing reproduction or complete edition-union claim.
